about: A bell flower, 1.7 m: three arching grown stems each hanging a translucent cyan jellyfish bell over a bright core with two tendrils. Separate core and halo meshes; authored at peak, breathed by the audio clock. Origin at the base's centre.

acoustics.about: materials carry glTF extras {"acoustic": <preset|"none">}; large near-level meshes carry node extras {"acoustic": <preset>} (what the game reads); relief, trim, clutter and plants are left out

lights.City_GlowCyan: cyan core, emissive at peak; the game breathes with the audio clock
lights.City_GlowCyanHalo: cyan halo shell (alpha 0.25), at peak with its core
